Definitely one of the hidden gem on steam.

Pretty much stands out for its outstanding style of artwork with some really cool and original functions added inside the game, up to 4K live-CGs with freely zoom in-out; cute mini games for example. Real life based on story shows the developers having a descent taste and understanding of adults’ lifestyle.  Moments that hit readers hard emotionally which drag you into seeking the meaning behind the story. 

Down side: it’s a kinetic visual novel, which has the story set, your only options trigger on H- scenes which don’t affect how the story goes. You’re not playing a particular character. No voice besides H parts. BGMs are kinda repetitive. English localization isn’t good enough, confusing lines will happen sometimes, though for a small budget project, it can be understood.


All in all, still worth getting it certainly, based on its amount content with the low price it offers.

P.S Getting the 18+ adult content is vital, no adult romance can be told vividly with sex being absence.
